description.text:
This is a gizmo, a collection of nodes saved to a file by creating a group and then selecting "save as gizmo".
The gizmo creator should change the string returned here by changing the value of the "help" knob before saving the gizmo.
Show this node in the bookmark list.
Always keep the output of this in memory so that it can be read quickly when changing things connected to it.
Pass default input through this node without any processing.
Always show this node's animation in the dopesheet.

Color for this node's controls in the viewer.
X indicates the color is unset and uses the Preferences/DefaultNodeGLColor value.
Use the right click menu to revert to unset.
Don't draw the arrows going into this node when it is not selected.

Text to display on the node.
Some html is accepted.
The end frame after which the node will behave as if disabled.
The start frame to enable the node from.

Name of the node, used to refer to it in expressions.
Valid names start with a letter or underscore and may only contain letters, digits and underscores.
Display a small image on this node in the Node Graph indicating its output.

Specify the frame number to use for a static postage stamp. This is only used when the postage stamp mode preference is set to 'Static frame'. If the frame number is outside the frame range for the node, it will be clamped.

Color of this node's icon in the graph.
/ indicates the color is unset and uses the Preferences/Node Colors value, if any.
Use the right click menu to revert to unset.
When checked the node is only enabled between the specified frame ranges, outside of the frame ranges it behaves as if disabled.
